name: Block Builder
summary: The factory: describe a job, then generate blocks.
description: How a block moves from an idea to a published, published-ready, first-party block. The operator describes the job and gives examples; the builder fetches an LLM answer, walks the candidate pipeline (rules, VADER or spaCy, SetFit), evaluates every candidate version against a held-out set, and packages the winner as a block. No code is written to a package until the eval clears the gate. Run with the user's own keys only — nothing is hosted.

integrations.name: openreel
integrations.description: A Herdr bridge for design-system handoff (describe the job to the generator and read the result back).
